chunks: they said by way of pride and vanity. “Now you order half of it to come to you and the other half of it remain (in its place).”
The Holy Prophet ordered the tree to do the same. Then half of the tree advanced towards him in an amazing manner and with greater humming. It was about to touch the Prophet of Allāh.
Then they said, disbelieving and revolting, “Ask this half to get back to its other half and be as it was.”
The Prophet ordered it and it returned.
ai.seo_question: What miracle did the Prophet Muhammad perform with a tree to demonstrate his authority to the people?
ai.summary: This narrative from Nahj al-Balagha describes the Prophet Muhammad's (SAWW) miracle of the tree, often associated with the Tribe of Thaqif, where he commanded the tree to split in half to demonstrate his divine authority over nature. When the people, filled with pride and vanity, doubted his power, he commanded one half to approach him, showcasing his control over the natural world as a sign of prophethood. The event highlights the theme of divine power manifesting through the Prophet to counter human arrogance and skepticism.
